title: portwright service note frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a services/<id>.md verified-procedure note. Reference/contract doc; bin/portwright lint enforces this with the Python stdlib (no jsonschema dependency at runtime).

version_tag.description: Service/MCP version this procedure was verified against.

last_verified.description: YYYY-MM-DD the procedure was last confirmed fresh.

endpoint.description: The connection transport this service is reached over (MCP server, HTTP API, OAuth app, or local CLI).

human_steps.description: Only the unavoidable human-only steps, reflecting the current tool UI.

agent_can.description: What the agent does on its own once connected.

freshness_evidence.description: Explicit public official documentation URL refreshed by update. Downloads provide evidence, not automatic Procedure approval.

profile_ids.description: Profiles this Procedure is bound to (empty = any).

distributable.description: true = safe to ship via git; false = personal note kept under services/_private/.
